summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Adly Mansour, focused on his education. It states he was born in Cairo and traces his academic path through Cairo University in law and economics and then France's École nationale d'administration. The note covers only these education milestones and dates.
one_line: Biographical note on Adly Mansour, covering his birth in Cairo and his law, management and ENA education.
key_facts: Adly Mansour was born in Cairo.
Adly Mansour graduated from Cairo University Law School in 1967.
Adly Mansour earned a postgraduate degree in law in 1969.
Adly Mansour studied economics and earned a postgraduate degree in management science from Cairo University in 1970.
Adly Mansour later attended France's École nationale d'administration (ENA).
Adly Mansour graduated from École nationale d'administration (ENA) in 1977.
